test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.**

He said that his new slippers were very comfortable.

options.text: He said, “His new slippers were very comfortable.”
He said, “My new slippers are very comfortable.”
He said, “My new slippers were very comfortable.”
He said, “His new slippers have been very comfortable.”

solution:
The correct answer is **He said, “My new slippers are very comfortable.”**

• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the question, we have to change it into Direct Speech.
